# Pet Assure

> Pet Assure is America's leading veterinary discount and wellness plan provider, offering pre-existing condition coverage and affordable pet healthcare alternatives since 1995.

Pet Assure provides membership-based veterinary discount plans and wellness coverage for dogs and cats across the US, Canada, and Puerto Rico. The platform serves as an alternative to traditional pet insurance, with a focus on covering pre-existing conditions and routine veterinary care through their flagship Veterinary Discount Plan and Mint Wellness plan.
